sentences.text: Nostic Waters Oy is a newly registered company, entered in the register on 2026-10-07 under the industry code 47763, retail sale of pets and pet food.
First sales are recorded on 2026-10-07, and a start-up notification and a board change were registered on 2026-10-08.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the registered industry is pet retail and the record shows no ocean use.
